svg.title: Exact move card by arm and test set
svg.desc: Exact move card with 95% CI for every arm on three test sets. Unseen scenes: our head 89.0% and 89.4% (two seeds), Depth Anything 3 plus rules 62.0%, COLMAP 20.0% and 20.4%, Qwen3-VL-8B 6.5%, static floor 5.9%. Unseen move pairs: head 53.6% and 50.8%, DA3 plus rules 51.0%, COLMAP 21.4% and 32.0%, Qwen3-VL 0%. Big Buck Bunny moving windows: head 70.6% and 64.7%, DA3 plus rules 76.5%, COLMAP 0% and 11.8%, Qwen3-VL 0%.
